Favrskov is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is tracked in national clinical quality registries. Specifically, it is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, focusing on metrics such as Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. This indicator relies on data from the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) and the National Patient Register (LPR) [^src1]. Favrskov's local performance data—including specific figures on stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients—is detailed in the municipality-level breakdown on page 95 of the report, underscoring its role in local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Because the available corpus is limited to this specific statistical table, there are no other named related entities, relationships, distinct claims, or timeline events associated with Favrskov in the provided data.
